tracks.name: Sepang International Circuit
tracks.notes: PETRONAS Sepang International Circuit, Selangor. ~5.543 km; hosts MotoGP, WSBK, ARRC, and MSBK. Official site https://www.sepangcircuit.com (not hyphenated sepang-circuit.com).

tracks.name: Johor Circuit (inactive / redevelopment)
tracks.notes: Pasir Gudang, Johor. INACTIVE — prolonged closure / multi-year redevelopment. Do not present as a currently active race or track-day venue until reopening is confirmed. Historical club-level asphalt only.
